name: SSH Windows hosts

# Managed orcad against a real Win32-OpenSSH server on 127.0.0.1 (inbox capability and the pinned
# 10.0.0.0p2-Preview release), on x64 and arm64. Each job provisions a private sshd service and one
# standard account per cell (config/ci/windows-ssh-provider/), hides the host toolchain from SSH
# sessions behind logging shims, and deploys orcad on the pinned node.exe in both DefaultShell cases.
